# Kyoto Family Trip Snapshot: 2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13

A relaxed 4-day plan for 2 adults + 2 kids, built around one main activity per day, mostly transit, and kid-friendly food.
Budget target: **JPY 180,000 total** excluding international flights.

## 4-Day Kyoto Itinerary with Costs and Transit

### Day 1: Higashiyama Welcome Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Main activity:** Kiyomizu-dera area + Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka stroll
- **Transit:** Kyoto Station → Kiyomizu-gojo area by bus/taxi, about **20–30 min**
- **Walk time:** Temple area to lanes and snack stops, **15–25 min between points**
- **Kid-friendly meal:** Yudofu set, curry rice, or udon near Higashiyama
- **Rainy-day backup:** Kyoto National Museum or Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art

**Estimated cost**
- Transit: **JPY 2,000–3,500**
- Entry/activity: **JPY 1,500–2,500**
- Meals/snacks: **JPY 10,000–14,000**
- Total: **JPY 13,500–20,000**

### Day 2: Arashiyama Easy Nature Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Main activity:** Arashiyama bamboo grove + riverside area
- **Transit:** Kyoto Station → Arashiyama by JR or bus, about **20–30 min**
- **Walk time:** Station to bamboo grove, **10–15 min**; grove to river area, **10–20 min**
- **Kid-friendly meal:** Soy milk donuts, tofu dishes, soba, or simple set meals
- **Rainy-day backup:** Kyoto Railway Museum

**Estimated cost**
- Transit: **JPY 2,000–3,500**
- Entry/activity: **JPY 0–2,000**
- Meals/snacks: **JPY 10,000–14,000**
- Total: **JPY 12,000–19,500**

### Day 3: Fushimi Inari and Tea Stop
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- **Main activity:** Fushimi Inari Taisha lower trail and iconic gates
- **Transit:** Kyoto Station → Inari Station by JR, about **5 min**
- **Walk time:** Station to shrine entrance, **3–5 min**; short family loop, **45–90 min**
- **Kid-friendly meal:** Inari sushi, grilled mochi, ramen, or rice bowls nearby
- **Rainy-day backup:** Nishiki Market covered food walk + nearby department store food floor
Media: Alt=Rainy-day backup:** Nishiki Market covered food walk + nearby department store food floor, Kyoto, Japan

**Estimated cost**
- Transit: **JPY 1,500–3,000**
- Entry/activity: **JPY 0–1,000**
- Meals/snacks: **JPY 10,000–14,000**
- Total: **JPY 11,500–18,000**

### Day 4: Nijo Castle + Central Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Main activity:** Nijo Castle grounds and a calm central Kyoto afternoon
- **Transit:** Kyoto Station → Nijojo-mae area by subway/bus, about **15–25 min**
- **Walk time:** Castle entrance to main route, **10–15 min**; nearby lunch stop, **10 min**
- **Kid-friendly meal:** Tempura set, omurice, pasta, or family restaurant options
- **Rainy-day backup:** Kyoto Aquarium or Kyoto International Manga Museum

**Estimated cost**
- Transit: **JPY 2,000–3,500**
- Entry/activity: **JPY 2,000–4,000**
- Meals/snacks: **JPY 10,000–14,000**
- Total: **JPY 14,000–21,500**

## Budget Plan and Family Fit

| Day | Main focus | Transit time | Estimated total |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Apr 10 | Higashiyama | 20–30 min | JPY 13,500–20,000 |
| Apr 11 | Arashiyama | 20–30 min | JPY 12,000–19,500 |
| Apr 12 | Fushimi Inari | 5–10 min | JPY 11,500–18,000 |
| Apr 13 | Nijo Castle | 15–25 min | JPY 14,000–21,500 |

**Trip total estimate:** **JPY 51,000–79,000**
That leaves a comfortable buffer for extra snacks, taxis, souvenirs, or a nicer dinner while staying under **JPY 180,000**.

### Why this works for your family
- **Low pace:** one major attraction per day, with built-in rest time
- **Transit-friendly:** all days are easy by JR/subway/bus
- **Kid-friendly:** short walks, snack stops, and flexible backup indoor options
- **Budget-safe:** plenty of room under your cap even with comfortable meals

## Packing Checklist for Kyoto in April

- Light jacket or compact umbrella
- Comfortable walking shoes for adults and kids
- Layered tops for cool mornings and mild afternoons
- Small daypack with water bottles
- Tissue packs and hand sanitizer
- Portable charger and phone cables
- Cash and IC card for transit
- Basic rain covers for backpacks
- Small snacks for the kids
- Any allergy medicine or motion-sickness remedies
